narrative: Operators can now declare Copier modules in repo overlay configs; gw apply renders and commits them atomically to every matching branch via the Git Trees API — no pull requests, no partial states. gw plan previews the overlay diff offline before anything is committed. Teams request permitted modules through policy-gated self-service, and the recording transport makes the no-PR contract machine-checkable across every code path.
